The year, month by month                                                        
Open any month for its full story, visual evidence, and daily record.           
                                                                                
April 2026 · 01 Apr–30 Apr                                                      
▸ Tasks return to view (/papers/barkpark-changelog-2026-04)                     
  Work focused on returning the full picture instead of something partial or    
  misleading. People can trust that what they see is the whole story.           
  Edition · 223 verified changes                                                
                                                                                
May 2026 · 01 May–31 May                                                        
▸ Failures now explain what happened (/papers/barkpark-changelog-2026-05)       
  Missing or failed results now say what happened instead of dressing an error  
  up as an empty or successful page.                                            
  Edition · 419 verified changes                                                
                                                                                
June 2026 · 01 Jun–30 Jun                                                       
▸ Mutate halt returns the canonical error envelope (not a bare string)          
(/papers/barkpark-changelog-2026-06)                                            
  Errors and awkward states were made easier to understand and recover from.    
  Less guesswork when something needs attention.                                
  Edition · 782 verified changes                                                
                                                                                
July 2026 · 01 Jul–31 Jul                                                       
▸ Barkpark Cloud makes site status easier to understand (/papers/barkpark-      
changelog-2026-07)                                                              
  Site health and release state became clearer, with awkward and refused actions
  leaving a useful explanation behind.                                          
  Edition · 3,120 verified changes                                              
                                                                                
August 2026 · 01 Aug–31 Aug                                                     
▸ A bare-string was spread character by character, so the page never revalidated
(/papers/barkpark-changelog-2026-08)

  misleading. People can trust that what they see is the whole story.           
  Edition · 1,669 verified changes
